finding: Bank credit willingness stable but economic outlook weighs on Slovak firms
bullets: A net 7.8% of Slovak firms (n=310) reported that banks' willingness to provide credit improved, unchanged from the previous wave and above the EA's net 5.6%.
A net 51.6% of Slovak firms (n=472) reported that the general economic outlook deteriorated, worsening by 7.2 pp from wave 38 and 22.2 pp below the EA's net 29.4%.
A net 21.2% of Slovak firms (n=310) reported deterioration in access to public financial support, improving from a net 33.8% in the previous wave, compared with the EA's net 13.6%.
chart_subtitle: Net 7.8% of Slovak firms reported improved bank credit willingness.
